title: Your month
caption: On the first of the month Leo opens his recap. Only he can see it. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: In My Waypoints, This month opens a recap of the current month for your account only: posts shared, reactions given, thumbs up and laughs received, and the feeling you logged most. It is never shared or public.

cast.leo: Leo, a young man with a light beard, a black cap and a denim shirt

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera on a rooftop in the morning light, a relaxed smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Leo's story. It is the first of the month, and he is curious how his last month went.
